journal.text: Initial $50,000 portfolio: deploy $40,000 across seven names and retain $10,000 cash. Reviewed 65 sessions for 20 candidates through Dec 31. Favor sustained relative strength: GOOGL rose from 243.10 to 313, ROST 152.39 to 180.14, MNST 67.31 to 76.67; MU and LRCX show strong quarter and December trends. LITE has exceptional momentum but extreme volatility, so cap initial allocation at 6%. NVDA is a smaller recovery position, back above much of its December range. Avoid weaker MSFT/META quarter trends and recent AVGO breakdown. Broad year-end pullbacks justify reserve rather than full exposure. Target weights: GOOGL 16%, ROST/MNST 14% each, MU/LRCX/NVDA 10% each, LITE 6%, cash 20%. Review weekly for trend persistence, daily for sharp deterioration. Reconsider on closes below GOOGL 296, ROST 174, MNST 72, MU 248, LRCX 155, NVDA 174, LITE 316; these are review thresholds, not guaranteed execution stops. Reduce if breaks persist or correlated technology weakness broadens; add reserve only with renewed strength. Use dollar buys because opening prices are unknown.

Hold all seven positions and $10,000 cash (19.8% of $50,566 equity). Jan 2 confirmed strength in MU (+10.5% close-to-close), LRCX (+8.1%), LITE (+4.8%) and ROST (+1.4%); no holding breached its review threshold. MNST weakened to 76.16 but remains above 72. Avoid chasing a single sharp semiconductor session given existing correlated exposure; allow the initial positions time to develop. Reconsider reserve deployment after sustained strength or an orderly pullback, and reduce exposure if trend breaks persist. Review thresholds remain GOOGL 296, ROST 174, MNST 72, MU 248, LRCX 155, NVDA 174, LITE 316; reassess MU sooner if its breakout reverses below 285. These are decision levels, not executable stops. Broader trend review later this week.

Hold seven positions and $10,000 reserve (19.7% of $50,678 equity). Jan 5 strength in ROST and LRCX offset weakness elsewhere; GOOGL advanced and MU retained most of its breakout. LITE fell 7.5% on 5.79m shares, roughly double Jan 2 volume, a warning but not yet a breach of the original trend threshold. Its modest 5.6% portfolio weight limits exposure; do not average down. Review LITE for a reduction on a close below Jan 5 low near 345 or continued heavy-volume weakness; original major review level 316. MNST has declined four consecutive sessions but remains above 72. Other review levels: GOOGL 296, ROST 174, MU 285 for breakout failure (248 major trend), LRCX 171 after its sharp advance, NVDA 174. Levels are review triggers, not executable stops. Mixed participation and volatile semiconductor gaps do not justify spending reserve today. Reassess broader trends later this week, or sooner if weakness accelerates.

Hold seven positions and $10,000 reserve (19.3% of $51,829 equity). Jan 6 reinforced MU and LRCX momentum with roughly 10% and 6% gains on rising volume. LITE reversed its prior selloff, closing 397.42 near its high on 5.62m shares; its 339 intraday low highlights substantial volatility, so keep exposure near 6% and do not chase. ROST continues higher; MNST stabilized, while GOOGL and NVDA remain range-bound. Existing exposure captures leadership without deploying reserve into steep short-term advances. Raise nearer-term review levels to MU 309 and LRCX 185, their recent breakout support areas; review LITE below 345 on a closing basis. Other review levels remain GOOGL 296, ROST 174, MNST 72, NVDA 174. These prompt reassessment, not automatic stops. Broader weekly trend review by Friday; consider reserve deployment after consolidation rather than vertical gains, and reduce if breakout failures persist.

Hold seven positions and $10,000 cash (19.3% of $51,878 equity). Jan 7 GOOGL gained 2.4% on increased volume, while NVDA and MNST improved. MU, LRCX and ROST pulled back modestly on lower volume than Jan 6, not enough to invalidate their advances. LITE remains volatile but recovered from its opening gap to finish 392.88; retain its limited 6% weight without adding. No holding breached review levels. Existing semiconductor/optical exposure is about 38% of equity, so avoid chasing recent sharp gains with reserve cash. Review levels remain MU 309, LRCX 185, LITE 345, GOOGL 296, ROST 174, MNST 72 and NVDA 174 on closes; breaches prompt reassessment rather than automatic orders. Conduct broader weekly trend and candidate review next session; consider new deployment only with favorable consolidation or stronger diversified opportunities.

Weekly review: rotate LITE into a modest $3,000 REGN position (~5.8% equity), retaining approximately $9,754 cash at prior closes; actual proceeds depend on opening prices. LITE fell 11.4% to 348.26 on 5.14m shares, near its session low, reversing Jan 6's recovery. Although barely above the 345 closing review level, repeated large downside reversals and elevated volume undermine the setup; exit rather than average down. REGN offers diversification away from semiconductor/optical exposure: rising December trend and Jan 7 breakout above the 793 area, followed by a lower-volume pullback to 801.01. Review below 763, and reconsider adding only after sustained support near 780-793. Hold GOOGL, ROST, MNST, MU, LRCX and NVDA. MU/LRCX are pulling back but retain breakout support; no additions after their steep advance. Review closes below MU 309, LRCX 185, NVDA 174, GOOGL 306, ROST 179 and MNST 72. Candidate comparison: AMZN and MAR have strengthened but are extended short term; WMT and GILD remain choppy. Revisit LITE only after stabilization and reclaiming 375, not merely an intraday bounce. Review new position and technology weakness next session.

Hold seven positions and $9,643.54 cash (18.5% of $52,250 equity). Jan 9 confirmed strength in GOOGL, ROST and MNST; MU recovered to 345.09 and LRCX broke higher to 218.36. Retain winners without chasing these sharp advances; combined MU/LRCX/NVDA exposure is about 32.3%. Raise LRCX closing review level to 195, the recent pullback low area, while MU remains 309. NVDA lagged again at 184.86 but selling volume declined; monitor 183 support and reassess below 174 rather than rotate solely on one weak week. New REGN position closed 796.55 after a wide-range reversal on lower volume; no addition until support around 780-793 is sustained, and review below 763. Other closing review levels: GOOGL 306, ROST 179, MNST 72. No current breach warrants selling. Reconsider reserve deployment after consolidation or confirmed diversified strength; next session focus on REGN support and whether NVDA weakness broadens.

Exit REGN's failed breakout; hold other six positions. Jan 12 REGN reversed from 810 to 768, near its 765.08 low, on 1.321m shares (versus 0.712m Friday and above breakout-day volume). Loss of 780-793 support and full reversal of Jan 7 strength invalidate the entry setup even though the 763 closing review threshold is not yet breached. Do not average down. Reconsider only after stabilization and sustained recovery above 793. Sale raises cash to approximately $12,513 (23.9% of $52,346 equity), subject to unknown opening fill. GOOGL and ROST continue higher; MNST remains stable; MU and LRCX hold strong advances, while NVDA held 183 support without a decisive recovery. Keep winners rather than chase or increase correlated semiconductor exposure (~32.3%). Closing review levels: GOOGL 311, ROST 185, MNST 72, MU 321, LRCX 195, NVDA 174 with nearer support at 183. Reassess sustained NVDA weakness, any support breaks, or diversified consolidation opportunities before deploying reserves.

Hold six positions and $12,502.28 cash (23.9% of $52,283.69 equity). Jan 13 GOOGL, ROST and MNST continued higher; MNST strength came on increased volume. MU (-2.2%) and LRCX (-2.7%) pulled back but remain above review levels; avoid adding to semiconductor exposure (~31.8% including NVDA). NVDA improved to 185.81 and again held 183, so no exit on relative weakness alone. Maintain closing review levels GOOGL 311, ROST 185, MNST 72, MU 321, LRCX 195 and NVDA 174; a sustained loss of NVDA 183 warrants earlier reassessment. Candidate check: AMZN retreated to 242.60 without stabilization, MAR is consolidating near 323, and GILD remains choppy. WMT has strengthened sharply to 120.36 after a high-volume gap, but avoid chasing its two-session surge or increasing retail overlap with ROST immediately. Reconsider reserve deployment on a supported consolidation; reassess holdings on support failures or sustained high-volume reversals. No new setup compelling enough to trade today.

Hold six positions and $12,502.28 cash (24.1% of $51,853.79 equity). Jan 14 pullback has not breached closing review levels. GOOGL recovered near its daily high; ROST remains above recent support. MNST fell on increased volume: monitor follow-through rather than add. MU selling volume eased, but LRCX declined 2.6% on increased volume; retain both above 321 and 195 respectively, with no increase to combined semiconductor exposure (~31.5%). NVDA undercut 183 intraday then recovered to 183.14; this is not yet a sustained closing breakdown. Reassess a close below 183, especially with a failure to recover, rather than wait mechanically for 174. Other closing review levels remain GOOGL 311, ROST 185 and MNST 72. AMZN and MAR weakened further; WMT is holding its surge but has only one consolidation session, while GILD's rebound lacks volume confirmation. Preserve reserve rather than force an entry. Reconsider on confirmed support failures or a supported diversified consolidation.

Hold six positions and $12,502.28 cash (23.9% of $52,271.53 equity). Jan 15 NVDA recovered to 187.05 on higher volume, resolving the immediate 183 support concern. ROST recovered; GOOGL and MNST remain above support. MU and LRCX closed higher but surrendered most of their opening gaps and finished near daily lows: do not chase these rebounds or increase combined semiconductor exposure (~32.0%). Monitor MU 328 and LRCX 206 as nearer warning levels; closing breaks of 321 and 195 respectively warrant stronger reduction review. Other closing review levels: GOOGL 311 (nearer warning 325), ROST 185, MNST 72; reassess NVDA if it again closes below 183 and fails to recover. Reserve candidates remain unconfirmed: AMZN's bounce was modest, MAR improved on higher volume but needs follow-through, WMT pulled back on rising volume, and GILD reversed its rebound. Preserve cash pending a supported diversified entry or clearer consolidation rather than force turnover. Reconsider holdings on sustained support failures or further high-volume gap reversals.

Hold six positions; cash $12,502.28 is 23.7% of $52,744.91 equity. Jan 16 MU broke higher to 362.75 on sharply increased volume; LRCX followed through to 222.96. Let winners run rather than chase or increase semiconductor exposure (32.8%). Raise MU nearer review level to 336 (failed breakout warning below 352); LRCX warning 217, stronger review below 206. GOOGL slipped to 330 on increased volume: watch 325, then 311. ROST also declined on increased volume but remains above 185; MNST held firm, with nearer warning at 76.8. NVDA again faded its opening gain but remains above 183; sustained loss warrants reduction review. Candidates: AMZN stabilized but remains below 241-243 resistance; MAR held its rebound without decisive follow-through. GILD's strong rebound to 124.91 merits monitoring for a hold above 122 before deployment. WMT recovered with exceptionally large reported volume, which alone is not a reliable directional signal; retail overlap discourages an immediate addition. Preserve reserve until a clearer diversified entry or supported consolidation. Reconsider on the closing support failures above, rather than intraday noise.

Exit NVDA: Jan 20 gapped below the repeatedly tested 183 support, failed to reclaim it all session, and closed near its low at 178.07 on increased volume. This is a clearer breakdown than prior intraday undercuts; retain stronger MU and LRCX rather than the semiconductor laggard. Sale raises cash to approximately 33% of equity at reference prices (actual open unknown). Hold other five positions. GOOGL breached the 325 warning but remains above 311; reassess on further weakness or failure to regain 325. ROST remains above 185. MNST broke higher; raise nearer review to 78, do not chase. MU retained its breakout but reversed substantially from its intraday high: monitor 352 then 336. LRCX held well; monitor 217 then 206. GILD held above 122 but has not cleared 126 convincingly; retain as diversified candidate rather than force immediate redeployment. AMZN and MAR weakened, WMT reversed; preserve reserve. Reconsider NVDA only after a supported reclaim of 183-187, and deploy cash when diversified candidates show sustained strength.

Initiate $4,500 GILD (~8.4% equity): after three sessions holding above 122 intraday, it closed at 129.11 near the daily high and above the entire supplied 25-session range. Volume was healthy but below the previous two sessions; use a modest starter rather than chase at full size. Healthcare adds diversification without more semiconductor exposure. Cash after purchase $12,718.10 (~23.8% reference equity). Review GILD on a close back below 126; sustained loss of 122 invalidates the entry. Add only after supported consolidation, not another vertical move. Hold five existing positions: GOOGL reclaimed 325, ROST recovered, MNST retained its breakout, and MU/LRCX extended strength. MU nearer warning raised to 361, stronger review 352; LRCX 217 then 206. GOOGL watch 325 then 319/311; ROST 185; MNST 78. Avoid adding to extended chip winners. NVDA reclaimed 183 but remains below 187 and lacks sustained recovery; do not immediately reverse yesterday's exit. AMZN and MAR remain unconfirmed, WMT offers less diversification. Reconsider on closing support failures or supported new entries.

Hold all six positions and $12,718 cash (23.9% of $53,207 equity). Mixed Jan 22 action argues against adding risk: ROST fell 2.8% on increased volume and closed near its low; LRCX reversed a gap-up sharply, although volume eased. Both still hold previously identified support. Review ROST for reduction on a close below 185 or continued heavy-volume weakness; LRCX below 217, with 206 the stronger trend threshold. MU closed near its high after a wide intraday swing; retain the winner without chasing, raising nearer warning to 376 and retaining 361/352 as deeper review levels. Combined MU/LRCX exposure is 24.3%, manageable without an immediate trim. GOOGL held its recovery above 325; watch 325 then 319/311. MNST consolidated on lighter volume; watch 78. New GILD position followed through above 129 on increased volume; no addition after another extended session, review below 126 then 122. AMZN remains below 241-243, MAR has not regained 326, and NVDA remains below 187 with lighter recovery volume. Preserve reserve for supported consolidation or a better diversified entry. Reconsider promptly on closing support failures rather than react to intraday noise.

Hold six positions and $12,718 cash (23.8% of $53,427 equity). Jan 23 evidence remains mixed but does not justify turnover. ROST recovered to 188.55 on lighter volume, retaining 185 support. LRCX undercut 217 intraday but closed at 217.94 on declining volume; do not treat the intraday breach as a confirmed breakdown. Reduce on a closing loss of 217 with continued weakness; 206 remains the stronger trend threshold. MU advanced to 399.65 but faded from 412.43; retain without chasing, watching 376 then 361. Combined MU/LRCX weight is 24.1%. GOOGL closed near its daily low but remains above 325; watch 325 then 319/311. MNST reached 82; watch 80 then 78. GILD accelerated to 135.93 on increased volume: favorable follow-through, but too extended to add; raise nearer warning to 129, retaining 126/122 as deeper review levels. AMZN approaches but has not reclaimed 241-243; MAR remains below 326. NVDA closed above 187 for one session with modest volume, insufficient confirmation to reverse the recent exit while chip exposure remains substantial. Preserve reserve for supported consolidation or diversified opportunity; reconsider promptly on closing support failures.

Hold six positions; cash $12,718 (23.8% of $53,471 equity). Jan 26 closes preserve existing trends without offering a compelling new entry. GOOGL rebounded to 333.26; retain above 325, with 319/311 deeper review. LRCX recovered to 222.87 after another intraday dip below 217; no confirmed closing breakdown. Reduce if it closes below 217 with continued weakness; 206 remains deeper trend support. MU pulled back to 389.09 on declining volume; retain, watching 376 then 361. Combined chip exposure 24.0%; no addition. ROST weakened to 187.57 on increased volume but remains above 185; reduce on closing support loss or persistent distribution. MNST reversed a fresh high to close near its low at 81.16 on increased volume: watch 80 closely, then 78; do not add. GILD advanced to 137.78 near its high; retain without chasing, watching 133 then 129, with 126/122 deeper review. AMZN still below 241-243, MAR weakening below 326, and NVDA failed to sustain 187. Keep reserve for supported consolidation or stronger diversified opportunity. Reconsider promptly on closing support failures.

Trim ROST by 12 shares and initiate $3,500 AMZN. ROST has repeated higher-volume declines since Jan 21, most recently to 186 on 3.27m shares after an intraday loss of 185. Closing support is not yet broken, so retain the majority but reduce exposure to persistent distribution; reconsider remaining stake below 185 or renewed selling. AMZN reclaimed watched 241-243 zone, closing 244.68 near session high with volume above the preceding three sessions. Small starter (~6.4% of equity), not a full allocation: overhead resistance remains 247-249 and recovery volume is not exceptional. Review on loss of 238, exit consideration below 234/231; add only after sustained breakout or successful support retest. Expected cash roughly $11,450, subject to opening fills. Hold GOOGL, MNST, MU, LRCX and GILD. MU/LRCX combined 25.1% of equity; strong Jan 27 advances justify retention, not chasing. MU watch 389 then 376; LRCX 223 then 217. GOOGL watch 325 then 319; MNST 80 then 78. GILD remains extended at 140.97: no addition, watch 137/133 then 129. Reassess all on closing support failures. All decisions use prices through Jan 27 only.

Hold seven positions; equity $54,730 with $11,450 cash (20.9%). Jan 28 closes do not invalidate positions. MU advanced strongly to 435.28 on rising volume; let winner run without adding to extended chips. MU/LRCX combined 25.8% of equity: watch MU 410/399 then 389 and LRCX 229/223 then 217; reconsider reduction on failed breakout and continued weakness. GOOGL holds 336, watch 325 then 319. ROST stabilized at 186.04 on sharply lower volume after yesterday's trim; retain reduced stake unless closing loss of 185 or renewed distribution. MNST at 80.92 remains above 80, with 78 deeper support; no addition. GILD pulled back on lighter volume to 139.72 after strong advance; watch 137/133. New AMZN starter faded from 247.78 to 243.01 on increased volume: insufficient follow-through to add, but 241-243 support region remains intact. Review below 238, exit consideration below 234/231; require sustained 247-249 breakout or convincing support retest before increasing. Preserve cash rather than chase recent sharp advances. Decisions use only data through Jan 28; reconsider on closing support failures.

Hold seven positions. Equity $54,945, cash $11,450 (20.8%); MU/LRCX 26.1% combined. Jan 29 saw wide intraday ranges but recoveries in GOOGL, MU and LRCX, not closing breakdowns. Keep winners without adding to extended semiconductor exposure. Tighten LRCX review to 237 then 229/223; MU watch 417/410 then 399. GOOGL recovered from 326.54 to 338.25 on increased volume; watch 325 then 319. ROST again defended approximately 184.7 and closed 186.50; retain trimmed position, reconsider below 185. MNST closed 80.04 near its low, but declining volume and no closing loss of 80: no addition; reduce if weakness persists below 80, with 78 deeper support. GILD consolidated at 139.55 on lower volume; watch 137/133. AMZN briefly lost 238 but recovered to 241.73 on higher volume; small starter remains valid, though follow-through is weak. Review closing loss of 238, exit consideration below 234/231; no addition without sustained 247-249 breakout or convincing support stabilization. Preserve reserve; reassess closing support failures next session. Only observations through Jan 29 used.

Monthly $50,000 deposit raises equity to $104,343; deploy $14,000 in stages, leaving $47,450 cash (~45.5%). Initiate WMT $7,000: January advance followed by orderly retracement and two-session recovery to 119.14, latest rise on increased volume. Review below 115.5-116; add only on successful retest or sustained break above 121.6. Initiate BKR $4,000: strong January trend, latest pullback to 56.04 on contracting volume and recovery from 55.04. Small size because extended; review below 54.8/53.8, reduce on failed support. Add $3,000 GOOGL: repeated recoveries and consolidation near 338, unlike sharp semiconductor reversals; total position roughly 11% of equity. Review 325 then 319. Retain other holdings. MU reversed from 455.5 to 414.88 on rising volume and LRCX fell to 233.46 on rising volume: no averaging up; combined exposure now only 13% following deposit. Reduce if MU loses 407-410 with follow-through (399 deeper), or LRCX closes below 229 (223 deeper); first warning levels 417/237 have failed. MNST recovered 80 on higher volume; ROST recovered to 188.65 after repeated 184.7 defenses. Watch MNST 79.5/78 and ROST 185. GILD strong at 141.95 but extended, watch 138/137. AMZN remains weak at 239.3: no addition; reconsider below 238, exit consideration 234/231. COST falling and META fresh gap reversal do not justify new allocation. Reassess deployment after support holds or new breakouts; cash is intentional amid chip volatility. Only data through Jan 30 used.

Deploy another $4,500 of monthly cash in measured additions: ROST $2,500 after repeated 184.7 support defenses and recovery to 190.11 on increased volume; MNST $2,000 after reclaiming 80 and closing 81.10 near the session high on markedly increased volume. Resulting positions approximately 7.2% and 8.9% of equity; cash $42,950 (~40.7%). Reconsider these additions if ROST closes below 185 or MNST below 79.5; deeper MNST support 78. Hold remaining positions. WMT breakout to 124.06 is strong but a 4% session gain is not an attractive immediate chase; watch retention of 121.6 and 119. GOOGL 343.69 confirms strength, already 11% weight; watch 325/319. MU rebounded from 410 to 437.80 but on less volume than Friday's reversal; LRCX recovered only partially to 237.50. No chip additions until volatility settles; review MU below 407-410 and LRCX below 229. BKR defended 55.27, retain with 54.8/53.8 review levels. GILD remains strong; watch 138/137. AMZN defended 238 but remains below 247-249 breakout region: hold small starter, reconsider below 238 then 234/231. Further deployment requires orderly support tests or sustained breakouts, not one-day chip rebounds. Only prices through Feb 2 used.

Hold; cash $42,949.74 (40.8%), equity $105,295.72. Feb 3 showed renewed technology reversals while defensive holdings advanced. MU retested 407.53 and recovered to 419.44; LRCX pierced 229 intraday but closed 230.10. No additions: reduce on closing LRCX loss of 229, especially 223, or MU closing loss of 407-410 with follow-through (399 deeper). AMZN reversed on increased volume to 238.62 after touching 235.45; small 3.2% position remains above closing review level 238, exit consideration 234/231. GOOGL reversed from 349 to 339.71 but remains above 325/319 support; retain. Yesterday's ROST and MNST additions have positive follow-through: 191.12 and 81.97; watch 185 and 79.5/78 respectively. WMT rose another 2.9% to 127.71 on strong volume; avoid chasing a roughly 7% two-session advance, watch 123.65/121.6 before considering additions. BKR recovered to 58 near its session high; retain, watch 55.27/54.8. GILD 143.28 remains constructive, watch 138/137. Preserve reserve rather than deploy into wide-range technology reversals or extended defensive advances. Reconsider additions after orderly consolidation/support tests; reconsider existing risk promptly on closing support failures. Only prices through Feb 3 used.

Reduce failed technology trends. Exit LRCX: Feb 4 close 209.78 broke both 229 and 223 on expanding volume, near session low. Sell half MU: 379.40 broke 407-410 and deeper 399 on highest volume of last five sessions; retain only ~3% equity exposure, not averaging down. Exit AMZN: 232.99 below 238/234 after repeated failed recoveries, close near low. Sales raise cash to approximately $55,371 (53% at prior closes; actual open unknown). Retain GOOGL despite high-volume decline to 333.04 because 325/319 support remains intact; reduce if 325 fails, especially 319. Retain ROST/MNST above 185 and 79.5/78; no additions following reversal days. WMT, GILD and BKR remain relatively strong but extended; do not chase. Watch WMT 123.65/121.6, GILD 142/138, BKR 56.16/54.8. Remaining MU: exit consideration on close below Feb 4 low 363.90 or failed recovery toward 399; additions require stabilization and sustained reclaim of 407-410. Reentry LRCX requires base and reclaim of 223-229; AMZN reclaim 238 with follow-through. Preserve capital now; reconsider deployment after orderly support tests or durable strength, rather than automatically reinvesting sales. Only prices through Feb 4 used.

Hold; cash $55,127.15 (53.3%), equity $103,482.74. Feb 5 data do not justify reversing yesterday's risk reduction. GOOGL gapped down to 312.22 and traded 306.46 but recovered to 331.25 near its high on very heavy volume; this is not a closing support failure, though gap risk is elevated. Retain existing 10.9% weight without adding; reduce on close below 325, especially 319. MU defended 363.90 and recovered to 382.89 on lighter volume; keep residual 3.1% position, no averaging down. Exit review below 363.90; additions require stabilization and sustained reclaim of 399 then 407-410. ROST consolidated at 189.23 and MNST at 81.75; retain, review below 185 and 79.5/78 respectively. GILD advanced to 149.37; do not chase, watch 145.9/142. WMT pulled back to 126.94 with higher volume; wait for orderly stabilization, review below 123.65/121.6. BKR reversed to 57.36 on increased volume; no addition, review below 56.16/54.8. Cash remains deliberate protection against unstable technology trends and extended defensive prices. Reconsider deployment after multi-session stabilization or orderly support tests; reassess closing support breaks promptly. Only prices through Feb 5 used.

Reduce GOOGL by half after Feb 6 close 322.86 broke 325 review level. Its 2.5% decline and failed prior-session recovery contrast with sharp NVDA/LRCX rebounds; retain only ~5.3% equity exposure while 319 remains intact. Review remaining position for exit below 319, especially 306.46; additions require sustained recovery above 331-333. Estimated cash after sale ~$60,643 at prior close (actual opening fill unknown). Hold other positions: MU improved to 394.69 but remains below 399 and 407-410; no addition until sustained reclaim, review below 363.90. LRCX reclaimed 229 at 231.01 but one large rebound is not a base; require follow-through before reentry. ROST 190.74 and MNST 82.54 remain constructive; review below 188/185 and 79.5/78 respectively. GILD 152.50 and WMT 131.18 are extended after strong advances; retain rather than chase, review 145.9 and 126.56 respectively. BKR recovered to 58.92; retain above 56.9/56.16. Substantial cash reserve is deliberate while technology recovery remains unconfirmed; reconsider deployment on orderly consolidation or sustained reclaimed support. Only data through Feb 6 used.

Hold; cash $60,609.81 (58.5%), net worth $103,664.81. Feb 9 evidence is mixed, with no closing exit threshold breached. GOOGL recovered from intraday 317.26 to 324.32; retain reduced position, review exit on close below 319 and require 331-333 recovery before adding. MU fell to 383.50 on lighter volume, still between 363.90 support and 399/407-410 recovery levels; no addition. MNST reversed to 80.90 on increased volume; watch 79.5 closely, reduce on closing failure, deeper support 78. ROST broke recent highs at 194.50 but on light volume; retain, watch 190 then 188/185. WMT 129.02 and GILD 151.68 pulled back without breaking support; review 126.56 and 145.9 respectively. BKR 59.55 remains strong; review 56.9/56.16. LRCX tested 223.39 and closed 229.28, not yet compelling follow-through beyond 232.45. NVDA reclaimed 190 but approaches 193-194 resistance after a rapid rebound; AMAT also recovered, while CSCO is extended. Preserve cash rather than chase this rebound; reconsider modest technology deployment on sustained recovery or an orderly higher-low consolidation. Only data through Feb 9 used.

Exit remaining GOOGL after Feb 10 close 318.58 breached the 319 review level: another lower high/low and failure to sustain the Feb 5 rebound. Reentry requires stabilization and recovery of 331-333, not merely a one-day bounce. Expected cash roughly $66,052 at prior close (~64% of equity); actual open unknown. Hold other positions without additions. MU 373.25 weakened on increased volume; review exit below 363.90, additions only after sustained 399/407 recovery. MNST 80.17 fell on increased volume; reduce on close below 79.5, deeper support 78. WMT 126.70 barely held 126.56 on a closing basis; review reduction on closing failure, deeper support 123.65. GILD 147.23 had a high-volume pullback; review below 145.9, then 142. ROST 192.33 remains above 190/188 supports; BKR 59.15 remains above 56.9/56.16. NVDA 188.54 and LRCX 226.61 do not confirm breakout follow-through, so keep reserve rather than force replacement trades. Reconsider deployment after sustained recovery or orderly higher-low consolidation. Only data through Feb 10 used.

Initiate a modest $4,000 LRCX position (~3.8% of equity) after Feb 11 close 235.12 reclaimed the Feb 6 rebound high 232.45, following two lower-volume pullback sessions. Volume improved to 9.56m but remains below the initial rebound, so this is a starter, not a full allocation. Review reduction if close loses 226.61; exit review below 220.25. Add only after holding 230-232 or sustained recovery above 240.34. Cash after purchase $62,058.98 (~59.7% at prior valuations), preserving flexibility with opening prices unknown. Hold existing positions: MU surged to 410.34 on increased volume, but require sustained 399/407 support before adding; review below 386.57 then 363.90. GILD 155.80 and BKR 61.25 made strong advances; avoid chasing, review below 147.07 and 58.43 respectively. WMT rebounded to 128.77 while preserving 126.56 closing support; retain, reduce on closing failure. MNST 80.79 remains above 79.5 review level; ROST 192.54 remains above 190/188. NVDA remains below 193-194 resistance. GOOGL deteriorated to 310.96 after our exit; no reentry without stabilization and 331-333 recovery. Only data through Feb 11 used.

Hold; net worth $104,198.63, cash $62,058.98 (59.6%). No existing closing review threshold breached through Feb 12. LRCX 231.29 retreated on increased volume after starter purchase; no addition despite holding 230-232, since follow-through is unconvincing. Review reduction below 226.61 and exit below 220.25; renewed strength above 240.34 would improve the setup. MU 413.97 held above 407 but reversed from 438.77 to near its session low: avoid chasing; consider adding after orderly consolidation above 399/407, review below 386.57. WMT 133.64 broke recent highs on strong volume; retain existing exposure, consider addition after support develops near 130-132 rather than chase the jump; review below 126.56. GILD 151.81 pulled back without breaking 147.07 support. BKR 61.39 consolidated; review below 58.43. MNST 81.17 recovery remains on declining volume; watch 79.5. ROST 194.85 remains constructive but breakout volume is light; watch 190/188. NVDA failed again near 193-194 and closed near its low, reinforcing caution on technology deployment. Preserve reserve until stronger confirmation or orderly pullbacks.

Add $2,500 BKR after two lower-volume consolidation sessions following Feb 11's strong advance: Feb 13 low 60.25 held above breakout-day low 60 and close 61.20 remained near 61.25.
